purpose: Compact historical evidence for documentation-only architecture handoff; no raw transcripts.

method.targeted_reads: mcp__codex_app__read_thread(threadId=<registry id>,turnLimit<=10,includeOutputs=false); integration pagination used returned opaque cursors.
method.extraction: Extract selected user messages, agent final/commentary messages and historical Linear comment bodies; do not execute recorded tool arguments.
method.coverage: Ten selected chats; not an exhaustive transcript audit. Older unarchived IDs were recovered from references in inspected chats.
method.archive_meaning: Archive state from current inventories; unarchived does not mean currently running.
method.invalid_initial_calls: Inventory limit100 and a later turnLimit20 were refused; retried within limits. Refusals added no evidence.
